ColumnPhaseEntryHint: Capacity and criteria checked before a ticket enters, in every mode.
ColumnPhaseModeHint: After entry, choose what this column does next.
ColumnModeNoneHint: Keep entry rules; do not start an agent or JEV processing.
ColumnModeAgentHint: An agent carries out the mission. JEV can choose the next destination afterwards.
ColumnModeTriageHint: JEV chooses a destination on arrival, without starting an agent.
ColumnModeReview: JEV evidence review, then owner decision
ColumnModeReviewHint: JEV examines existing evidence; you approve or request corrections.
ColumnPhasePrepareHint: Ticket selection, execution profile and preliminary actions.
ColumnPhaseExecuteHint: Agent mission, model, skills and execution limits.
ColumnPhaseResultHint: At the end of the agent run, before any routing decision.
ColumnPhaseRoutingHint: Authorized destinations and the default route.
ColumnPhaseFinalizeHint: Final actions and transition to the destination.
ColumnPhaseReview: Examine criteria and evidence with JEV
ColumnPhaseReviewHint: Uses existing evidence; does not run additional tests.
ColumnPhaseTriageHint: On arrival, before any agent execution.
ColumnPhaseOwnerDecisionHint: Approve or request corrections after the JEV review.
ColumnOwnerDecisionHint: A sufficiently confident review waits for your decision, even when every criterion is satisfied. Corrections and overriding unmet or unverified criteria require a reason.
ColumnJevFallback: Call an agent if JEV cannot conclude or is unavailable
ColumnJevFallbackHint: Optional. Includes insufficient confidence or evidence, a missing key, exhausted service budget, or a service error.
ColumnJevNoFallback: The ticket stays in this column if JEV cannot conclude or is unavailable. No agent starts automatically.
ColumnJevUnavailableHint: JEV is unavailable. The selected fallback policy will apply; this mode can still be configured.
ColumnJevConfidenceHint: Below this confidence threshold, JEV cannot conclude. The configured fallback policy applies.
ColumnJevSelectProfile: Let JEV choose the model and skills
ColumnJevRouteAfterAgent: Let JEV choose the destination after the agent finishes
ColumnJevRoutingFallback: JEV chooses among the destinations below. If unavailable or uncertain, the classic outcome rules apply.
ColumnProofTiming: PASS, FAIL and PARTIAL require evidence. The agent report is saved before routing.
ColumnResultMemoryHint: The structured result and lessons are saved, then processor memory is updated.
ColumnActionsSuccessTiming: For a success route or automatic JEV routing, the transition is validated and recorded before configured actions run. On other routes, final actions run before the move.
ColumnDormantDraftHint: Only active stages are saved. Hidden stages keep their last saved settings.
